13:35 (forming) draws only §4.1's five hand-picked levels 64,009.0-64,013.0 (L220-224), not the 35 footprint.mjs rows the kit's base scene adds under them: with those, `24` §4.5 puts its POC at 63,998.0 (163 × 163 = 326 BTC) and adds a second ×3 buy stack, 64,005.0–64,007.9 at 2225 %, against the POC 64,011.0 (289 BTC) that §4.1 (L222), §4.7's tooltip and drawer (L329, L349) and §8.1's announcement (L731) state. A forming bar's traded range sits inside §3's upper bound (every row traded, L193); boards 20-23, 26 and 28 draw 13:35 the same way.

The 8 closed bars' low ledges (unfinished auction at 63,974.0, two-sided) lie below the window and are not drawn (replaces the kit's 'clip' note); 13:35's cap, both its ledges and every high ledge draw.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the base scene's 40 rows; the closed bars trade every row (§3 L193), so their wicks run from 64,013.0 to the window's bottom edge; 13:35's wick spans its five levels and its body is §4.1's ▌ rows 64,011.0-64,013.0 (L220-222); bodies are filled (their form is E12-D06's, D3) (replaces the kit's 'candles' note).

Box borders (§4.3 L271; Box is the default display, §6.2 L509): a 1 px light-grey (color.border.default) frame around each bar's traded levels in view and a 1 px rule between levels, under the outlines, rails and digits, as board 17 draws them (local box_borders() from gen_17.py: the kit's bar_column() draws digits only). The heat fill by colorScale is E18-D03's (§0 L29).

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 check glyph before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the sketch's '[FP *]', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1, L114, L139) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8, L115; §7.2 L267; contrast rows L493-495: the check is the ≥3:1 state carrier, the fill decorative); the fill alone (color.surface.selected on the paper) is lightness-only (§8.3 L771). Local press_marks() and rebuild_cluster(): the kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill only.

Comfortable chrome per E11-D02 §2 (L84, L86, L93): toolbar controls 32 px high (the kit's ctl() draws pill height), the env badge a 24 px pill (the kit draws 20), the cluster's fit and › segments 32 × 32 at the strip's top (y 0) and auto 32 px high, hugging its check glyph and word (50.5 px; a fixed 32 px cannot hold both); the cluster at x 1153.5 keeps 11.4 px after '13:35' (E11-D02's 8 px zone). The sketch's '>' (L227) is E11-D02's › ('Latest', §7.2 L267), drawn as the registry chevron-right glyph.

Composition names follow the catalogue (build notes '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)'): CMP-221 ChartToolbar, CMP-222 ChartTypeToggle · FP, CMP-003 SegmentedControl · Chart | Table, CMP-075 EnvBadgeLocal · DEMO, CMP-199 ChartLegend, CMP-223 DrawingToolbar, CMP-188 PriceAxis, CMP-189 TimeAxis and the cluster CMP-189 + CMP-004 (E11-D02 L78); renamed after the kit builds them (local cmp_names()).

Carry for PR #4180 (not raised from this offline round; for the coordinator): §4.1 L224 to hand-pick the two cells so that no sketch cell gains an outline; against the drawn 64,008.0 rows (62 × 147 and 186 × 50) the allowed values are 13:25 bid 235–2,105, ask 21–185 and 13:30 bid 68–602, ask 63–557. Never a cell state (§4.2 L264-265).

§4.1 L221's short label '×3 buy' in the free margin is not drawn: at comfortable the margin beside the newest bar is 37.3 px (1,192 − 9 × 128.3) and the label 39.6 px (type.num.sm) + 2 px, so D5 (L155) / §4.4 L290-291's 'elsewhere on hover, focus and selection' applies (the kit's free-space test); the 3 px bracket carries 'active'.

Edge levels are not compared (kit 'edges'): `24` §4.2's zero policy, treat_as_min by default and not exposed (L792; §6.2 L536), treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero, which would add 10 outlines in view: a sell at every bar's high 64,013.0 (9, 13:35's 3 in 3 × 18 among them) and a buy at 13:35's low 64,009.0, making its stack ×4 64,009.0–64,012.9. The board follows §4.1's 'three outlined cells' (L233). Carry for PR #4180 (not raised from this offline round; for the coordinator): an A-row to `24` §4.2 ('edge levels are not compared') or, if `24` stands, an amendment to §4.1 L233-235.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
